details.jobDescription: The ICT Security Consultant is part of a cyber security team implementing enterprise grade cyber security solutions both from a networking and from a procedural point of view. You will be working with the IT Security, Anti-Fraud, Data-center and Networking departments of our customers. To find the most efficient way to protect the system, networks, software, data and information systems against any potential attacks. To implement vulnerability testing, threat analyses, and security checks. To perform the research on cyber security criteria, security systems, and validation procedures. To plan and design healthy security architectures for any IT project. To investigate and provide security solutions using business standard analysis criteria. To deliver technical reports and official papers relating to test findings. To give professional supervision and guidance to security teams. To update and upgrade security systems as required. Attractive salary package Cool projects to work on ︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉
